channel.title: Canada Immigration Daily
channel.description:
Canada Immigration Daily brings you the latest Canadian immigration news and policy updates in plain language, every morning.
From Express Entry draws and LMIA updates to Provincial Nominee Programs, work permits, study permits, family sponsorship, and citizenship, we cover the developments that matter to newcomers, temporary residents, and aspiring Canadians.
Every story is verified against official government sources.
Produced by PGL Canadian Immigration Services, led by Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant Rej Jerome Pagal (CICC Licence R705735).
Visit https://pglimmigration.com

item.title: BC Entrepreneur Draw: 10 Invites, Score 118 | Oct 22, 2026
item.description:
• British Columbia's October 20 Entrepreneur Immigration round invited ten Base stream candidates and fewer than five Regional stream candidates, both at a minimum score of 118 — one point below the September 22 round, confirmed on the province's official Invitations to apply page (last updated October 20, 2026)
• New Brunswick's September 25 and October 2 Atlantic Immigration Program rounds selected 63 applications for endorsement processing across seven occupational groups — construction, education and community services, manufacturing, other trades, professional and IT, sales and services, transportation — confirmed on the Government of New Brunswick's official invitation and selection rounds page; the tenth AIP round of 2026
• November 3 is twelve days away: new Express Entry high-wage scoring takes effect, and job-offer details must be in profiles before then for the points to count; IRCC may pause draws during the recalculation
• The new online refugee claim portal also takes effect November 3 — unfinished claims must be submitted by November 2 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern time

item.title: IRCC Stats: New Arrivals Down 63% | Oct 21, 2026
item.description:
• IRCC's application statistics, updated October 20 (data through August 31): combined student and temporary worker arrivals fell 63% in January to August 2026 versus the same period in 2024 — 326,900 fewer arrivals, confirmed on IRCC's official Inside IRCC's application processing system page
• 216,600 new permanent residents through August — 57% of the 380,000 Levels Plan target (economic programs 127,100; family 59,100; refugees and protected persons 25,500). Asylum claims down 68% versus 2024; 217,960 citizenship grants through August
• Proof of citizenship: August was IRCC's strongest month of 2026 with 3,955 certificates finalized, up about 63% from July; 135,965 applications still pending
• Newfoundland and Labrador: two selection rounds — October 9 (131 invitations: 130 NLPNP + 1 AIP) and October 16 (126: 125 NLPNP + 1 AIP), verified on the province's official ITA updates page; 2,952 invitations in 2026; invited candidates have 60 days to apply
• Looking ahead: November 3 is 13 days away — new Express Entry high-wage scoring begins; job-offer details must be in profiles before then; new refugee claim portal takes effect

item.title: New Brunswick AIP Eases Occupation Limits | Oct 20, 2026
item.description:
• New Brunswick has eased Atlantic Immigration Program endorsement restrictions, effective October 14 — endorsements can now be submitted for all occupations except four (shippers and receivers, restaurant and food service managers, food service supervisors, and fish and seafood plant workers), verified on the Government of New Brunswick's official Important notices page
• New employer designation intake stays paused for the rest of 2026, and candidates outside Canada remain limited to NB-led recruitment in health care, education, and construction — eligibility does not guarantee selection
• The 2026 International Experience Canada season is now closed (pools closed October 19); invited candidates can still complete their work permit applications, and everyone else can create a new profile when the 2027 season opens
• Looking ahead: November 3 is two weeks away — Express Entry job-offer details must be in profiles before then to earn the new high-wage points, and the new refugee claim portal takes effect the same day
• Quiet day otherwise: no new federal draws, IRCC newsroom releases, or provincial draws in the last 48 hours

item.title: IEC Final Round: 2026 Season Closing This Week | Oct 19, 2026
item.description:
• International Experience Canada's 2026 season is closing — the final invitation round for all remaining pools happens the week of October 19; profiles had to be in before 9 a.m. Eastern today (verified on IRCC's official IEC rounds page, updated Oct 16)
• If you're in an IEC pool, watch your IRCC account closely this week — an invitation opens the path to a work permit, but a profile never guarantees one
• Already invited or mid-application? You can still complete and submit your work permit application after the season closes
• Looking ahead: Express Entry's new high-wage scoring takes effect Nov 3 — job-offer details must be in profiles before then; the refugee claim portal replacement also takes effect Nov 3
• Quiet otherwise: no new federal draws, no IRCC newsroom releases, no provincial draws, no Canada Gazette immigration items since the weekend

item.title: Express Entry Overhaul: 150 Points, No LMIA | Oct 17, 2026
item.description:
• Express Entry scoring overhaul announced Oct 16, effective Nov 3: new labour-market integration factor — up to 150 CRS points (140 with spouse) for high-wage Canadian work experience or a qualifying job offer • LMIA no longer required for qualifying job offers to earn the new points or meet Federal Skilled Worker/Trades job-offer requirements (genuineness checks remain) • Profiles in the pool recalculate automatically; job-offer details must be in profiles before Nov 3; invitation rounds paused up to two weeks during recalculation • Ontario launches new REDI initiative round (through end-2027): nomination spaces in Greater Sudbury, Kenora District, Nipissing District, Rainy River District, Renfrew County, Thunder Bay • BC PNP Rural/Remote Health Support draw (Oct 15): 16 invitations, minimum score 54, for health-authority cleaning/security roles in rural communities
